paragraphs.text: Seth Dickinson is an American writer of fantasy and science fiction, best known for the 2015 debut novel The Traitor Baru Cormorant and its sequels The Monster Baru Cormorant and The Tyrant Baru Cormorant .

Dickinson graduated from the University of Chicago, receiving the Dell Magazines Award for Undergraduate Excellence in Science Fiction and Fantasy Writing in 2011 for the short story "The Immaculate Conception of Private Ritter". Dickinson has published short fiction in Clarkesworld , Strange Horizons , Lightspeed , and Beneath Ceaseless Skies , among others. Dickinson also contributed to writing for video games.
Exordia , Dickinson's fourth novel, a science fiction story introducing a new setting, was released in January 2024.
For Wizards of the Coast , Dickinson wrote the Magic Story of Edge of Eternities .
